mapper.insert: insert into business_pubcar_car_attr(attr_id, register_date, engine_num, frame_num, accident_situation, group_id, b_id, operate) values (#{attrId}, #{registerDate}, #{engineNum}, #{frameNum}, #{accidentSituation}, #{groupId}, #{attrBId}, #{operate})

insert into pubcar_car_attr(attr_id, register_date, engine_num, frame_num, accident_situation, group_id, b_id) select t.attr_id,t.register_date,t.engine_num,t.frame_num,t.accident_situation,t.group_id,t.b_id from business_pubcar_car_attr t where t.operate= 'ADD'
and t.b_id= #{attrBId}
